messages:
Maria (Marketing): Quick sync: NimbusAI case study confirmed. They agreed to a 30-min interview next Wed 14:00 UTC. Need: final quote, legal sign-off on metrics, SVG logo, headshot, 1-2 dashboard screenshots, and a mini press kit so Sales can route inbound leads. Who owns what?
Clara (Customer Success): I can own scheduling and recording. Will set Zoom, capture transcript, and ask for a 2-3 sentence live quote.
Tony (Sales): For routing, please add a demo CTA and tag leads with "case-study-inbound". I'll draft a one-pager playbook for AEs.
Jason (Product): Draft metric phrasing from Nimbus briefing: 
"With Redwood we saw 3x lower generation latency at ~25% lower per-token cost in peak runs, enabling faster user flows and cheaper scaling."
I'll upload the experiment screenshots to the drive.
Elaine (Legal): Customer approved narrative but requested test context for any precise numbers (model, batch size, quant). Prefer relative phrasing + attribution. Please add: "– NimbusAI, Engineering" and cc me for final sign-off. Also no PII or raw logs.
Maria (Marketing): Good. Clara, when you ask for the quote, record exact wording and confirm attribution. I'll draft the blog, social blurbs, and email snippet by Mon EOD for review. Target publish next Thu.
Clara (Customer Success): Calendar invite set for Wed 14:00 UTC -> 1898765432-zoom. Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NIMBUS-CASEKIT. Will upload transcript and pull 3 short pull-quotes. Also will request SVG logo + headshot.
Tony (Sales): For lead routing: can we have a landing form that sets utm=case_nimbus and auto-labels SFDC leads with "case_study: NimbusAI"? Dev/growth support needed to pipe leads to right AE queue.
Jason (Product): I'll add a short methodology bullet list describing model, batch sizes, quantization, and test harness to the drive so legal/context is clear.
Elaine (Legal): I'll review draft quotes and redlines by Tue 17:00 UTC. Share the draft in the doc so I can inline comments.
Maria (Marketing): Plan: blog + social + email draft Mon EOD. Webinar tie-in: 20-min webinar with Nimbus + Product in two weeks (separate thread).
Clara (Customer Success): Requesting that the live quote be <40 words so it fits hero.
Maria (Marketing): Noted. Hero will support a short quote plus a longer blockquote.
Tony (Sales): After publish, AE cadence for two weeks to follow up on case-driven signups. I'll drop the playbook in the drive.
Maria (Marketing): Action items recap: Clara = schedule + assets + transcript; Jason = screenshots + experiment context; Tony = lead routing spec + AE playbook; Elaine = legal review by Tue EOD; Maria = draft + publish plan. Tag me if timelines slip. :rocket:
Elaine (Legal): Confirmed. Will review Tuesday and leave comments.
Clara (Customer Success): After interview I'll upload clips and three candidate quotes to the drive for marketing to choose.
Maria (Marketing): Draft posted to shared doc. Tagging everyone for review later today. Thanks all!
